name: TribesPad
game: Tribes 2 (free official download) with the TribesNEXT client
notes: TribesPad owns its release recipe. The build downloads the free official Tribes 2 installer and the TribesNEXT client itself and checks them by SHA-256, so there is no game file to select. Personal builds contain translated game code and the game's data and are never published.

commands: brew install llvm@20 cmake ninja sevenzip zstd

steps: Open TribesPad. The game is already inside: choose LAN GAME, then HOST, enable bots and start an offline match. Sign with a profile that allows Extended Virtual Addressing (a paid Apple Developer account does).
Unzip {file}, move TribesPad to your Applications folder and open it. It needs no Apple account.
Choose LAN GAME, then HOST, enable bots and start an offline match.

off_mac.text: PadMint builds TribesPad on a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Without one, GitHub's free Mac runner can build the iPhone and iPad app in your own copy of TribesPad's repository; then install it with Sideloadly.
